actions.description: burst: comma list of actions, e.g. "download,share_download" or "delete"

download_only.description: Only download + verify (state `ready`), do not install.

url.description: Absolute URL or relative to the manifest URL (server / web / android).

add_names.description: Tag names to attach (created when missing).

replace.description: Replace the tag set of every path with `add` + `add_names`.

initialized.description: false until the first admin is created via POST /api/auth/init

code.description: Pickup code: `<code>`, `<code>-<pin>` or `<code> <pin>`; a full share URL also works.

source.description: local (hosted by this server) | manifest (release download)

oneOf.description: Client is older than the server's minimum: the client must upgrade.
Client speaks a newer API major than this server: the server must upgrade.

Compat.description: Outcome of negotiating a client against this server.

Effective.description: Effective configuration (config file / env merged with admin settings).

can_auto_install.description: The server can install updates itself (binary with data dir, or Docker with socket).

modes.description: any of anonymous | logged_in | password (combinable); empty list removes the gate

password.description: required when "password" is in modes (kept if omitted on update)

LastCheck.description: Result of the most recent check (stored in `meta`).

key_id.description: Key id that signed the manifest.

oneOf.description: Verified manifest (only ever set after its signature checked out).

min_client_version.description: Oldest web / Android client the new server still accepts.

enabled.description: When false the mount keeps its config but is omitted from listings and cannot be accessed.

kind.description: Driver kind: fs | s3 | webdav (rclone / OpenList bridge via webdav).

name.description: Top-level folder name in the virtual tree (no '/').

allow_download.description: Room / share: visitors may download (default true).

max_uploads.description: Room: max number of uploaded files.

paths.description: Virtual paths (files and/or folders) as seen by the caller.

perm.description: preview | download (default) | upload (collect files into the single shared folder)

room.description:
Drop room (快传房间): `paths` = [parent folder]; a fresh folder
`<parent>/.droprooms/<rand>` is created and shared as a whole.

task_id.description: Present when the operation runs as a background task (cross-storage copy/move).

visible_mounts.description: Mount names; `[]`… or null via `clear_visible_mounts` for all.

retention_days.description: Keep events this many days (0 = forever).

allow.description: read | download | upload | create | edit | delete | share

enabled.description: false when the requested mode is unavailable (semantic/hybrid in M1)

require_email_verification.description: Require e-mail verification before password login (default off).

dst.description: Full destination virtual path (including the new name)

color.description: gray | red | orange | yellow | green | teal | blue | indigo | purple | pink

UpdateSettings.description: Admin-editable update settings (stored in `meta`); empty / 0 = use the server config.

auto_check.description: Periodic background checks (manual checks still work when off).

interval_secs.description: Check interval override in seconds (0 = config default, minimum 60).

notify_email.description: Notify this e-mail address (uses the server mailer).

notify_webhook.description: Notify this webhook URL about available / installed / rolled back updates.

source_url.description: Manifest URL override ("" = config / GitHub Releases default).

window_start.description: Maintenance window for automatic installs, "HH:MM" UTC (both empty = any time).

UpdateStatus.description: Progress of the current / last update operation.

log.description: Step log of the operation ("<unix ts> <text>").

state.description:
idle | checking | downloading | verifying | ready | backing_up | installing |
restarting | health_check | rolling_back | succeeded | failed | rolled_back | manual

offset.description: Bytes already received; the next chunk must start here.

latest.description: Latest release seen by the update checker (None = never checked / checks disabled).

min_client_version.description:
Minimum client version required by the latest release (falls back to this server's
own `min_app_version`).

web_build.description:
Build id of the web bundle currently on disk (`<web_dir>/version.json`); a loaded
page whose own build id differs should offer a reload.
